description: National Physical Planning Development - Kotahena Sri Paramananda Purana Maha Viharaya is declared as an Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property matters. It declares a specific area of land (Kotahena Sri Paramananda Purana Maha Viharaya) as an Urban Development Area under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. The document includes detailed land descriptions, coordinates, boundaries, and survey information, which are characteristic of land-related gazettes. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the land declaration purpose and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would make it a hybrid government gazette.
